# DDM Architecture Flowchart Design History

This document archives all intermediate and final Mermaid diagrams explored during the co-design and architectural layout refinement of the **Dynamic Drought Module (DDM)** high-level system architecture (Slide 5 of [serverless_slides.qmd](file:///Users/brianyandell/Documents/GitHub/dynamic-drought-module/guides/serverless_slides.qmd)).

## 1. Selected Architecture: Option 3-V3 (Final Asymmetric Layout)

**Status**: Active in `guides/serverless_slides.qmd` (Slide 5).  
**Key Characteristics**: Vertical `Build & Edge CDN` on the left, horizontal `Community & Telemetry` on the right, and `Client WebGL Execution` positioned directly underneath `Community & Telemetry`. Utilizing compact rank spacing (`rankSpacing: 28`, `nodeSpacing: 36`) and `basis` curve splines, the diagram fits comfortably on the 1280×720 slide canvas with zero bottom cutoff.

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {
  'theme': 'dark',
  'themeVariables': {
    'fontSize': '14px',
    'fontFamily': 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'
  },
  'flowchart': {
    'rankSpacing': 28,
    'nodeSpacing': 36,
    'curve': 'basis'
  }
}}%%
flowchart TB
    %% Apex Top
    Dev(["💻 <b>TypeScript & Map Source</b><br/>• MapLibre UI & signals<br/>• Layer styles & configs"])

    %% Left Column: Build & Edge CDN (Vertical)
    subgraph ColBuild ["Build & Edge CDN"]
        direction TB
        Build(["⚙️ <b>Vite + npm Engine</b><br/>• Strict tsc typecheck<br/>• Minifies & chunks assets"])
        CDN{{"🌐 <b>GitHub Pages Edge</b><br/>• Global HTTPS CDN<br/>• Byte-range slicing"}}
        Build ==>|compiles| CDN
    end

    %% Right Column Container: Community on top, Browser directly under it
    subgraph ColRight [" "]
        direction TB
        subgraph ColData ["Community & Telemetry"]
            direction LR
            Tribal(["🌲 <b>Tribal Climate Partners</b><br/>• Co-design requirements<br/>• Hazard indicator zones"])
            Feeds[("📡 <b>Live Remote Feeds</b><br/>• USGS streamflow telemetry<br/>• NIFC wildfire & NOAA drought")]
            Tribal ==>|metrics & zones| Feeds
        end

        subgraph ColClient ["Client WebGL Execution"]
            Browser(["🖥️ <b>Visitor Browser (Client GPU)</b><br/>• MapLibre GL JS (WebGL GPU)<br/>• Streams vector tiles on demand<br/>• 100% serverless • Zero upkeep"])
        end

        ColData ==>|direct browser queries| ColClient
    end

    %% Connections from Dev
    Dev ==>|npm run build| Build
    Dev ==>|partner alignment| ColData

    %% Diagonal stream from CDN across to Browser
    CDN ==>|streams bundle & tiles| Browser

    %% Closed loop feedback (preserves top-down DAG ranking)
    Dev <-.-|field insights & telemetry| Browser

    %% Subgraph Styling
    style ColRight fill:none,stroke:none
    style ColBuild fill:none,stroke:#6366f1,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray: 4 4,rx:12,ry:12
    style ColData fill:none,stroke:#3b82f6,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray: 4 4,rx:12,ry:12
    style ColClient fill:none,stroke:#10b981,stroke-width:1.5px,stroke-dasharray: 4 4,rx:12,ry:12

    %% Node Styling
    style Dev fill:#1e293b,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Build fill:#1e1e38,stroke:#818cf8,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style CDN fill:#0f2937,stroke:#2dd4bf,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Browser fill:#0d3326,stroke:#34d399,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Feeds fill:#382414,stroke:#fb923c,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
    style Tribal fill:#27272a,stroke:#a1a1aa,stroke-width:2px,color:#f8fafc
```

## 2. Option 3 Refinements & Evolution

The sequence below demonstrates the iterative path leading to Option 3-V3.

### Option 3-V3 Asymmetric: Community & Client Moved Up

**Stage**: Option 3-V3 Asymmetric: Moving Right Stack Up (Step 668)  

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'theme': 'dark', 'themeVariables': {'fontSize': '14px', 'fontFamily': 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'}}}%%
flowchart TB
    %% Apex Top
    Dev(["💻 <b>TypeScript & Map Source</b><br/>• MapLibre UI & reactive signals • Layer styles"])

    %% Left Column: Build & Edge (Vertical)
    subgraph ColBuild ["Build & Edge CDN"]
        direction TB
        Build(["⚙️ <b>Vite + npm Engine</b><br/>• Strict tsc typecheck<br/>• Minifies & chunks assets"])
        CDN{{"🌐 <b>GitHub Pages Edge</b><br/>• Global HTTPS CDN<br/>• Byte-range slicing"}}
        Build ==>|compiles| CDN
    end

    %% Right Top: Community & Telemetry (Horizontal, beside Build)

        direction LR
        Tribal(["🌲 <b>Tribal Climate Partners</b><br/>• Co-design requirements<br/>• Hazard indicator zones"])
        Feeds[("📡 <b>Live Remote Feeds</b><br/>• USGS streamflow telemetry<br/>• NIFC wildfire & NOAA drought")]
        Tribal ==>|metrics & zones| Feeds
    end

    %% Right Bottom: Client WebGL Execution (Right under Community & Telemetry)

        direction TB
        Browser(["🖥️ <b>Visitor Browser (Client GPU)</b><br/>• MapLibre GL JS (WebGL GPU rendering)<br/>• Streams vector tiles on demand<br/>• 100% serverless • Zero upkeep"])
    end

    %% Dev branches
    Dev ==>|npm run build| Build
    Dev ==>|partner alignment| Tribal

    %% Right column vertical flow (Community down to Browser)
    Feeds ==>|direct browser queries| Browser

    %% Cross-column diagonal stream from CDN to Browser
    CDN ==>|streams bundle & tiles| Browser

    %% Closed loop feedback
    Dev <-.-|field insights & telemetry| Browser
```
